title: solidago nemoralis subsp. decemflora
intro: Solidago nemoralis subsp. decemflora, commonly known as Decenflora or Decemflora Goldenrod, is a subspecies of Solidago nemoralis, a flowering plant in the sunflower family. Decenflora Goldenrod is a medicinal plant that has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of Decenflora Goldenrod include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
